title: Correct final pressure
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the pressure at depth must be 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa.

title: Correct final depth
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the water depth must be 10 m.

title: Applies Boyle's Law
description: Important: The student correctly applies Boyle's Law (p₀V₀ = pV) to relate surface and underwater gas pressures and volumes.

title: Identifies gas volumes
description: Important: The student correctly identifies the initial gas volume (300 mL) and final gas volume (150 mL) from the given total and water volumes.

title: Uses hydrostatic pressure relation
description: Important: The student correctly uses the relation p = p₀ + ρgh to solve for the depth h.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student demonstrates consistent use of SI units (Pa, m, kg/m³) throughout the calculation.

title: Misinterprets gas volume
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the total bottle volume or water volume as the gas volume in Boyle's Law.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall: The student makes a sign error in the hydrostatic relation, e.g., using p = p₀ - ρgh.
